SITUATION
On a rain-damp Colombo roadside beside Kasun's small food three-wheeler, Anudi has turned toward him as he offers her phone. The practical return opens a shy, friendly connection.

PEOPLE
Anudi stands frame left, facing right in three-quarter view, in her established roadside outfit, holding an open umbrella in her left hand with her handbag on her left forearm. She is surprised and grateful. Kasun stands frame right facing her, in his established modest work clothes, with the food three-wheeler behind him; he is helpful and quietly receptive.

ACTION & DIALOGUE
Anudi follows the offered phone with her eyes and takes it into her right hand from Kasun's right hand, her eyebrows lifting slightly. He releases its edge and lets his right hand relax.

Anudi, to Kasun, warm and genuinely relieved, thanking this helpful stranger as she raises her eyes from the phone to his face:
අනේ, Thank you!
Kasun meets her eyes, his shoulders easing as he receives her gratitude.

Anudi, to Kasun, after a small natural pause, lightly surprised and a little self-conscious, acknowledging her oversight with a small smile:
මම දැක්කෙවත් නෑ.
Kasun listens without speaking, the corners of his mouth lifting slightly.

Anudi holds the phone at waist height in her right hand and keeps her small smile on Kasun. He returns the look, allowing the warmth to settle between them.

They speak casual, everyday spoken Sinhala, the way people really talk in a Sri Lankan teledrama: not an interview, not a speech, nobody looks at the camera. Only these words are spoken, only by the people named; English words in a line are said as Sri Lankans say them.

CAMERA
An eye-level waist-up two-shot from the road-facing side of the axis uses a 40mm lens and a steady frame on a tripod, keeping both faces and the phone exchange visible.

SOUND
Light rain patters on the umbrella, low Colombo road noise continues, and the phone handling is subtle; no music.

RULES
Hands: Kasun is not holding the phone. Anudi holds the phone in one hand. Clean frame: no captions, no subtitles, no watermarks. Text the description spells out (on a screen, a sign, a letter or a page) is rendered exactly as written; no other lettering is invented.

FORMAT
Aspect ratio 16:9. Duration 8 seconds. Ends on a cut.
